title: Kanssa with one companion
summary: Put a singular genitive before kanssa (“with”): Annan kanssa (“with Anna”).
prerequisiteSkills: Location postpositions with a singular genitive
objectives: Put a singular genitive before kanssa (“with”): Annan kanssa (“with Anna”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: Kanssa follows the companion expression: genitive noun/name + kanssa. It does not come before the noun as English “with” does.
Companion models: Anna → Annan, Liisa → Liisan, lapsi → lapsen, opettaja → opettajan.
The supplied verb frames are Olen (“I am”) and Tulen (“I come/am coming”). Personal-pronoun combinations with kanssa have additional written-Finnish forms and are outside this lesson.

steps: Use Annan before kanssa. The companion expression is a singular genitive; the speaker remains one person.
